Last year around this time, We’ve made 5 promises to you.
1: We said we will keep 50% or more market share in OLED, and we’ve accomplished it with 51%, so thank you.
2: We targeted OLED G and ultra large to be 40% of our OLED sales, and we are at 39%
3: We’ve had 50% growth in terms of QNED sales

And finally, our goal was to make OLED and Premium LCD to be about 46% of our whole sales, and we’re at 45%.
We appreciate your support in achieving our goals, and we would like to foster stronger ties with you so that we could accomplish goals for QNED in the future.
